description: Section, audit and scope notes from each console tab of the master workbook, preserved verbatim. Not catalogue entries.

Nintendo 64.text: Coverage | 76 classified games; 8 Fully Playable, 50 Mostly Playable, 18 Early Development. 8 unverified queue entries and 5 scope/exclusion entries are outside totals. Discovery indexes are candidate sources, not playability evidence.

Methods | Primary maintainer documentation, game-specific source/configurations and release/setup instructions reviewed. No local ROM builds or gameplay tests performed. Tags not independently confirmed are labeled; platform build targets are distinguished from tested gameplay.

October 12 highlights applied: 8 Full + 51 Mostly + 17 Early = 76 rated titles. Five selected report changes only; remaining findings are unapplied. Completion statements are attributed to maintainers; no independent gameplay run performed. Source access gaps remain pending.

PlayStation 1.text: PS1 v1.0 finalized 2026-10-04: Steps 1–4 complete. 190 classified game/prototype targets: 11 Fully, 70 Mostly, 109 Early. One unresolved candidate and 13 excluded/reference implementations remain outside totals. Completion of this pass does not make unverified metadata or private builds public.

Step 4 discovery: all 227 recomp-labelled PS1 repositories in the current recomp.fyi snapshot mapped to existing primaries, alternates or exclusions. Supplemental first-party catalogs/topics added Hellnight, Parasite Eve II and Resident Evil 1.5; Crash Bash resolved from the review queue. The latter is an unfinished 1996 prototype, distinct from retail Resident Evil 2. Discovery: https://recomp.fyi/?system=PS1 ; https://github.com/topics/static-recompilation ; https://github.com/topics/recompone ; https://github.com/alexbeavs-ps1-ports/psxrecomp-ports

Scope/primary changes: paused Vagrant Story prototype excluded; paused OpenGTPS1 retained as a reference and active GT2 source primary substituted (Mostly → Early). WWF SmackDown! 2 now uses Comfubar/KnowYourRoleRecomp (Mostly; Season load unconfirmed). PAL King’s Field resolves to US King’s Field / Japan II as an uncounted alternate. Colin McRae repository currently unavailable; Alpha 2 Gold fork has no established title-specific implementation. Japan original King’s Field remains one unverified review candidate.

Duplicate audit: 34 unselected index implementations reconciled; no duplicate game count. Regional aliases grouped, with King’s Field numbering preserved. Shared Spider-Man and Vigilante 8 repositories contain distinct game targets. Yu-Gi-Oh’s old Unchiga static track is no longer updated; its current matching-decomp successor is outside scope. BreathOfFire3PCPort concerns the 2001 Chinese PC version and is not a PS1 static recomp. Existing active static primaries remain counted once.

Steps 2–3 audited the original 187 targets. Step 2 checkpoints: 10, 30, 50, 70, 90, 110, 130, 150, 170, 187. Step 3 promoted Tsumu Light and Mega Man X6 to Fully, Parasite Eve and Xena to Mostly. X6 completion remains version-specific: issue #31 says 1.0.10 with inconsistent 1.0.1 references; current v1.2.0 has not been recertified. MK4 remains Early under explicit bootstrap_verified scope. Four Step 4 additions and replacement primaries received scope/release/classification review in this pass.

Eligibility: meaningful title-specific static translation/configuration required. Source-only work is Early unless substantial gameplay is documented; setup ZIPs alone do not prove playability. Fully can follow an explicit qualified maintainer full-playability/ending claim or verified completion. Active publicly documented projects with private implemented gameplay can qualify as Mostly; Parasite Eve II has no public source/build. Explicitly paused, inaccessible, retired static tracks, framework-only forks and matching decomps/source ports stay outside active totals.

Method/verification caveat: many PSXRecomp projects statically translate the resident EXE while interpreting or runtime-compiling overlays. Inclusion does not assert 100% AOT coverage. This is a documentation/package audit; no independent game binary or owned-disc gameplay run was performed. Evidence and version-specific qualifications are in column K.

Index release labels are snapshots rather than verified latest assets; README labels are attributed and may be stale. OS fields distinguish actual testing, available packages, build-only paths, simulation and Proton. Original-year gaps remain explicitly Unconfirmed. Existing Xbox 360, Original Xbox and Nintendo 64 baselines retain their data, classifications and formatting.

Other out-of-scope examples remain REDRIVER2, CTR-native, WipEout Rewrite, Silent Hill decomp and the current Yu-Gi-Oh matching-decomp port. Planned support and generic framework examples do not create classified game rows. No workflow step remains pending for PS1 v1.0; the single unverified candidate can be revisited when substantive evidence changes.

GameCube.text: Classification follows the existing Summary rules. Fully requires an explicit full-playability/beatable claim or verified completion. Mostly records substantial gameplay or a player build without complete progression proof. Early covers bring-up or isolated gameplay with major systems missing.

One primary implementation per distinct title enters console and overall totals. Alternate implementations keep their own rating and requirements in a separate section. Review leads, unavailable repositories, source ports and generic tools stay outside classified totals.

Primary choices: SunPad for Sunshine, BlueWake for Wind Waker and MeleePad for newer documented physical-device Melee matches and public setup. The previous macOS Melee choices remain alternates. Other alternates preserve their own ratings, supported input and build limits.

Gameplay and completion statements are maintainer/project evidence, not independent playthroughs. Existing Step 2 build inputs are retained. No game images or player executables were used. Primary documents and release notes checked 2026-10-04.

Source corrections: SunshineRecomp fixes the native return path, but its first-Shine evidence and unfinished controller/audio/product acceptance warrant Early. Deep Sea beta.4 release notes report progression through Outset beyond its older integration-status limits. Generated instruction/function percentages do not measure game completion.

Steps 1–4 complete after two existing-row batches of 20 plus new-lead batches of 20 and 3. Public indexes, repository searches and framework forks reviewed; both unavailable repos remain 404 with no replacement confirmed. Source ports, Wii/PS2 targets and generic tools excluded from primary totals.

Scope: Sunshine Eclipse and MKDD/Kirby are modded targets retained alongside their base games, with no extra retail-title count. Nightjar RE4 and Eternal Darkness boot claims lack a verified public native build. Source/version-file changes are not gameplay revalidation. Checked 2026-10-04; no game files or executables run.

Wii.text: Classification follows the existing Summary rules. Fully needs an explicit full-playability or completion claim. Mostly covers substantial gameplay or a public player build with unqualified progression. Early covers boot, isolated gameplay and source bring-up.

One primary implementation per retail Wii title is counted. Independent projects and platform forks retain their own ratings in Alternates. Matching decompilations, generic tools, empty repositories and untranslated profiles are outside game totals.

Primary choices: Starlight for Super Mario Galaxy, bt3recompiled for Budokai Tenkaichi 3, and the Robox web project for its explicit full-playability claim. GalaxyPad, MeteorRecomp and Robox desktop remain alternate implementations with their own limitations.

Gameplay statements are maintainer documentation or identified user reports. No game was built, launched or played in this audit. Public packages and source inputs were documented in Step 2; ratings do not guarantee every device, mode or clean-build configuration.

Wii Party is Mostly: the specific evidence covers Board Game Island and Free Play, while other modes and pair minigames remain unqualified despite broader roadmap wording. OpenMUA2 is Early for the retained static path; default-JIT results are not static gameplay proof.

Steps 1–4 complete. Step 3 was saved in batches of 20, 20, 20 and 13. Step 4 reviewed 20 additional repositories, then three fork leads and the Tatsunoko maintainer report; public indexes and broad/title-specific searches were cross-checked.

Final sweep added KartPad and VR PLUS as alternates, Spider-Man and private Tatsunoko as review leads, plus two scoped-out references. AstroCore is mentioned by Petari but no public binary-recomp implementation was confirmed. Matching decompilation projects and generic pipelines do not create game entries. Further VR/Strikers forks lack a separately verified platform/build and are deduplicated against their documented parent projects.

PSP.text: One primary per distinct retail title; independent ports remain Alternates. VCS public Windows/macOS player promoted to primary; original source profile retained as alternate.

Fully requires full playability/completion evidence. Mostly requires substantial documented gameplay without confirmed completion. Early includes boot/menu, isolated gameplay, source bring-up or major gameplay blockers.

Steps 1–4 complete: 22 rated titles (0 Fully / 11 Mostly / 11 Early), 4 alternates, 6 unresolved review leads and 14 references. Build audits checkpointed at 20/25; gameplay checkpoint saved before final sweep.
Yakumo requires PS3 Monster Hunter Portable 3rd HD Ver. NPJB40001 and remains reference-only. PSP CPU architecture does not turn that PS3 input edition into a PSP title.
Regional aliases and anthology microgames are deduplicated. Tutikumo supports Japan ULJM05500 (2nd G); Western Freedom Unite input is not verified.
